comment: Shared state-machine table for the task-dispatch contract. Both embedded implementations (Android/iOS) load this table for state names, labels and the transition list; behaviour is pinned by spec.md and the fixtures. States are per task; kind is work | review | pack. Review and pack rows are subtasks (parent_id = work task).

transitions.notes: Assignee mandatory (no task pool). Binds channel_id immutably when given.
Assignee only; rework reservation (reserved_for_id, until reserved_until) blocks others. Sets lease_until = now + lease_seconds.
Renews the lease only.
Renews the lease.
Renews the lease; records no event.
decision_reason=released. Work tasks do NOT return to the queue on release.
Event is recorded on the parent work task.
Parent work task -> needs_decision (decision_reason=review_released).

transitions.action: submit_result (work, pack agent exists and branch given)
transitions.notes: Creates a pack subtask (queued). Review opens when the delivery completes.
Creates a review subtask (queued) with an evidence snapshot. Event review_opened.
decision_reason=no_reviewer.
On the parent work task: opens review if a reviewer is set, else work -> needs_decision (decision_reason=no_reviewer, event pack_done). Work stays reviewing in the reviewer case.
Parent work (if still reviewing) -> approved, event approved; reservation cleared.
Parent work -> queued, round+1, reserved for its last claimer for one lease window. Event changes_requested on the work task.
Parent work -> needs_decision (decision_reason=rounds_exceeded). Event rounds_exceeded on the work task.
expected_version mandatory. Fields: title, goal, reviewer. State unchanged.
Clears claimer and lease; reserved for the new assignee for one lease window; assignee changes.
Open review/pack subtasks are cancelled in the same operation (event withdrawn on them). Repeating withdraw on a cancelled task is an idempotent no-op success.

round resets to 1; epoch increments by 1; verdict/feedback/summary/branch/commit/pr_url/delivery fields/lease/reservation cleared; original assignee kept; previous-round snapshot is written into the reopened event text.
Not a state: sets deleted_at/deleted_by. Lists exclude the task; get_task still returns it with the tombstone fields.
Runs on list/claim paths. Also clears expired reservations.
Parent work (still reviewing): opens review directly if a reviewer is set (event pack_skipped), else -> needs_decision (decision_reason=no_pack_agent).
